messages:
Harper: dropping a design idea for a regression timeline scrubber in the eval run diff view. intent: let reviewers scrub back through commits/deploys and see which change caused a metric regression. figma: https://figma.redwood/regression-timeline :mag_right: Dmitri: cool. main UX Q: do we treat the timeline as a visual only or as a control that updates the diff state (and history)? would prefer control so you can jump to a point-in-time and run comparisons. Leah: control + compare mode is key. two thumbs: 1) single scrubber position = view state at that commit 2) range select = compare two points (before/after). range select should show inline diff summary. Omar: backend note: we need a mapping from eval results -> commit sha / rollout id. we have that for most runs but not all. fallback: map to the closest deployment timestamp. missing metadata may show "Attribution unknown". Priya: accessibility: scrubber must be keyboard operable. keyboard pattern: Left/Right to move frame by frame, PageUp/PageDown to jump larger steps, Shift+Arrow for range selection. use aria-roledescription="timeline scrubber" and aria-valuetext to announce current selection. Harper: good a11y call. sample SR announcement suggestion: ``` aria-live="polite": "Viewing eval results at deployment v2026.03.15 (sha: a1b2c3). Metric: accuracy dropped 4%. Use arrow keys to move." ``` Dmitri: for visual density, show small sparkline above the scrubber with color-coded segments (green stable, amber regression, red drop). clicking a red segment opens the diff comparison. Leah: microcopy: tooltip on scrubber thumb: "v2026.03.15 — +/−4% accuracy (owners: infra-team)". Also add a tiny CTA: "Annotate" to leave an investigation note pinned to that timepoint. Omar: permissions: annotation should respect roles; only reviewers and owners can annotate, but annotations visible to all. store annotations with timestamp and optional link to a replay job id. Priya: keyboard SR examples for range-select: ``` aria-live="polite": "Range selected: v2026.03.01 to v2026.03.15. Compare 1,452 examples. Press Enter to open side-by-side diff." ``` Also ensure focus moves to the compare panel after opening and that the compare panel is reachable via TAB. Harper: performance: avoid preloading diffs for every frame. lazy-load diffs when user stops scrubbing for 300ms or explicitly selects a segment. show a skeleton while loading. Dmitri: telemetry: events: scrub_move (delta, step_type), scrub_select_point, scrub_select_range, annotation_created, attribution_missing. capture time-to-first-compare. Leah: UI variant debate: inline small compare vs full-screen side-by-side. propose inline summary for quick triage, and a "full diff" button to open side-by-side. keep both. Omar: backend constraint: side-by-side needs both snapshots; if snapshots differ in tokenization we need to normalize. add a preflight check and show a message "Normalization required; diff may be approximate." Priya: a11y checklist: keyboard controls, aria-valuetext with humanized dates, screenreader-friendly tooltips, focus management when opening compare, and ensure color not sole indicator (add icons/labels for regression state). Harper: copy for empty state when attribution missing: "No deployment metadata available for this run. Try mapping runs to deploys in Settings or inspect surrounding commits." suggestion: add a link to docs. Dmitri: implementation plan: frontend scrubber component + sparkline, backend mapping endpoint, annotations API, and telemetry. timeline: spike 1 week, prototype 2 sprints. Leah: QA: test with keyboard-only, test huge runs (10k frames) to validate virtualization, test SR announcements on NVDA/VoiceOver, and test annotation permissions. Priya: small aria example for focused thumb: ```
``` Harper: action items: Dmitri spike on data mapping, Leah to prototype UI + copy, Priya to write a11y acceptance criteria, Omar to spec backend annotation contract. sync Monday 11am for demo. :calendar:
